Read a TriOS RAMSES spectroradiometer data file

Source: R/trios.R
read_trios.Rd

Parses one or more spectra from a TriOS RAMSES `.dat` text file. Each spectrum is preceded by a `Comment` header line and terminated by a `[END]` marker. Data rows contain three whitespace-separated fields: index, wavelength (nm), and spectral radiance (mW m\(^{-2}\) nm\(^{-1}\) sr\(^{-1}\)). Radiance values are converted to W m\(^{-2}\) nm\(^{-1}\) sr\(^{-1}\). Negative instrument values are preserved; no clipping or other preprocessing is performed by this low-level reader.

Usage

read_trios(path)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the `.dat` file.

Value

A data.frame with columns:

spectrum

Character. Spectrum label from the Comment header.

lambda

Numeric. Wavelength in nm.

radiance

Numeric. Spectral radiance in W m\(^{-2}\) nm\(^{-1}\) sr\(^{-1}\).

Examples

# A synthetic one-scan TriOS file (radiance in mW/m2/sr/nm):
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".dat")
writeLines(c("Comment\tscan_1", rep("header_line", 29),
             paste(1:31, seq(400, 700, by = 10), seq(1, 4, length.out = 31),
                   sep = "\t"),
             "[END]"), f)
head(read_trios(f))
#>   spectrum lambda radiance
#> 1   scan_1    400   0.0010
#> 2   scan_1    410   0.0011
#> 3   scan_1    420   0.0012
#> 4   scan_1    430   0.0013
#> 5   scan_1    440   0.0014
#> 6   scan_1    450   0.0015
unlink(f)
